note: Preregistered before any action. Deterministic local mock; makes no claim about AI, browser, runtime, fairness, or performance.

treatment.route: direct fetch of the task detail resource, skipping the index and list pages
treatment.label: synthetic policy, not measured Trail advantage

rules.armFailure: An arm fails on any dispatch error (budget, size, deadline, usage, ceiling, transport, status) or any oracle reason on any of its four tasks; a failed arm is never retried.
rules.oracle: Exact answer fields plus the complete unique Summary line fetched from the authoritative detail page; semicolon-separated field=value entries must parse to exactly the evidence keys and truth values, with no duplicates or conflicting fields.
rules.aggregation: Per condition: arms passed of arms run, summed calls and summed synthetic tokens. Descriptive counts only; no comparison between conditions is a result.
rules.exit: 0 only if all 18 arms pass, every adversarial scenario is rejected with its expected code and request count, cleanup is clean, and before.json is unchanged; otherwise 2.
rules.reuse: An existing output path is refused.
